preamble.title: cardano-foundation/onboarding-batch-indexers
preamble.description: Batches of buy orders with a protocol fee, checked by every order, then once by a coordinator, from the onboarding Design patterns section

by_hand/Action.title: Action
by_hand/Action.description: What the spender wants to do with an order.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description:
Fill the order, as part of a batch. The index says where the order sits
 among the inputs, which is how the spend learns the book's hash.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Take the ADA back. Only the owner may, and never in a batch.

by_hand/Batch.title: Batch
by_hand/Batch.description:
What the coordinator is told: where each order's payment is, in the order
 the orders appear among the inputs, and where the fee is.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

mixed_by_hand/Action.title: Action
mixed_by_hand/Action.description:
What the spender wants to do with an order. The coordinator reads this
 too: it is how it knows which orders are filled whole and which in part.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description: Fill all of the order, as part of a batch.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Take the ADA back. Only the owner may, and never in a batch.

anyOf.title: PartialFill
anyOf.description:
Fill part of the order, as part of a batch. Its rest goes right after
 its payment.

mixed_by_hand/Batch.title: Batch
mixed_by_hand/Batch.description:
What the coordinator is told: where each order's payment is, in the order
 the orders appear among the inputs, and where the fee is.

mixed_with_library/Action.title: Action
mixed_with_library/Action.description: What the spender wants to do with an order.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description:
Fill the order, as part of a batch. Besides the indices, the redeemer
 carries the coordinator's credential: that is how the library picks out
 this book's redeemers from every other script's.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Take the ADA back. Only the owner may, and never in a batch.

mixed_with_library/Batch.title: Batch
mixed_with_library/Batch.description:
What the coordinator is told: each order's input index paired with its
 payment's output index, both going up, and where the fee is.

mixed_with_library/Filling.title: Filling
mixed_with_library/Filling.description: Whether an order is filled whole or in part.

order_book/Order.title: Order
order_book/Order.description:
What a buyer locks their ADA with: the token they want, how many, and where
 to deliver them.

per_order/Action.title: Action
per_order/Action.description: What the spender wants to do with an order.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description:
Fill the order, as part of a batch. The indices say where the order
 sits among the inputs, where its payment and the batch's fee sit among
 the outputs.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Take the ADA back. Only the owner may.

with_library/Action.title: Action
with_library/Action.description: What the spender wants to do with an order.

anyOf.title: Fill
anyOf.description:
Fill the order, as part of a batch: where the order sits among the
 inputs, and where the coordinator sits among the withdrawals.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Take the ADA back. Only the owner may, and never in a batch.

with_library/Batch.title: Batch
with_library/Batch.description:
What the coordinator is told: each order's input index paired with its
 payment's output index, both going up, and where the fee is.
